title: A replacement inherits an error bar
hook: Replacing a counter leaves a history that the new item did not earn.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Replace the minimum-frequency counter while retaining its inherited overcount bound.

misconception: A new tracked item's inherited counter is its exact frequency.
objective: Replace the minimum-frequency counter while retaining its inherited overcount bound.

claims.text: Replacement inherits the smallest counter rather than starting from zero. Its inherited error bounds the overcount: the displayed estimate minus error is a lower bound on that stored item’s true frequency.
